tagline: Next prompts one click away, never sent for you

cost.summary: Off by default, no model call. The `Suggest next steps` setting turns on a fork of your session after each finished turn to ask for the suggestions.
readme: By default this mod makes no model call. Turn on Suggest next steps (`/mod-next-steps settings`) and it calls a model, which spends tokens and counts against your plan quota.

After each finished turn of the main agent (not an interrupted one, not a subagent's), it forks your session to ask for the suggestions. The fork runs on your session's model and reuses the cached conversation, so a long session still makes a sizable request every turn.
With Suggest next steps off, the default, no request is made.

features.title: Suggestions
features.detail: After a finished turn, up to three one-line next prompts appear above the input, muted until the pointer is over one.

features.title: Click to fill
features.detail: A click puts the suggestion in the input for you to edit; nothing is sent.

features.title: Stays out of the way
features.detail: They clear when you send a prompt or a new turn starts, and a failed or interrupted turn shows nothing.
